a.lede: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.
a.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world

b.lede: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.
b.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
